systems.system: Distance education system (Train My Generation: Gabon 5000 online courses)
systems.owner: Ministry of National Education, with UNESCO
systems.tiers: online science courses for examination classes (3e and Terminale); 135 teachers trained in 2018-2019; a national distance system requested of UNESCO

note: UNESCO's Universal Periodic Review contribution covers education law, free schooling and distance learning; under 'digitalisation de l'éducation' it describes only online courses, and names no system holding school or learner records.
